title: National Museum gallery panel: MAHAYANA

author_institution: Department of National Museums, Sri Lanka
scope: National-museum synthesis on Mahayana/Vaitulya traditions, Abhayagiri/Jetavana and later Vajrayana/Tantrayana currents in Sri Lanka
limitations: Modern institutional synthesis read from a field photograph; individual dates, named transmitters and site attributions require independent source-specific corroboration.

title: National Museum gallery panel: HINDUISM
author_or_institution: Colombo National Museum / Department of National Museums, Sri Lanka
author_institution: Department of National Museums, Sri Lanka
scope: National-museum synthesis on Brahmanical/Saiva presence, Mahatittha/Gokanna, late first-millennium Hindu material and Chola-period consolidation
limitations: Modern synthesis; phrases such as 'major religion' are interpretive and not quantitative. Specific bronzes and literary attributions remain to be independently catalogued.

title: The Evolution of an Ethnic Identity: The Tamils in Sri Lanka c. 300 BCE to c. 1200 CE
author_or_institution: K. Indrapala / M.V. Publications for the South Asian Studies Centre
author_institution: M.V. Publications / South Asian Studies Centre
scope: Archaeological, epigraphic and historical synthesis of Tamil-speaking populations, Buddhism and Saivism through the Chola period
limitations: Broad synthetic monograph; individual temple, bronze and hymn claims should still be anchored to site-specific archaeological or philological publications.
